paragraphs: I'm Steve, a British-Canadian security technologist. My career has followed the way we build software—from application security and infrastructure as code to cloud-native systems and AI agents.

Along the way: Synopsys, Aqua, StackRox, Bridgecrew / Palo Alto Networks, and now Lakera / Check Point. The common thread is getting hands-on with emerging technology, finding the awkward questions, and making the answers useful.
I co-authored Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms for O’Reilly, and have helped bring people together through DSO Overflow, wired_in, and the DevSecOps London Gathering.
about.beyondTheKeyboard: I've represented Great Britain at Ultimate, play guitar and drums, and have strong opinions about beer. I enjoy building communities almost as much as building systems.
